_comment: Baseline hook set for generated teams (rules/hooks-integration.md). Portable: no jq (not preinstalled on stock macOS), every path anchored to CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (bare relative paths created nested .worklog trees in production), non-blocking failures suppressed. session-events.jsonl accumulates the RAW UserPromptSubmit event JSON, one object per line (the user's text is inside the .prompt field — consumers must parse JSON, not expect plain text). Name its consumer in the team CLAUDE.md; teams handling secrets drop that hook or add redaction. The matcher:startup SessionStart entry is the output-mode first-run ask (rules/output-structure.md, Output Mode Component): it stays silent whenever settings.local.json already names an outputStyle, and its guard must read ONLY settings.local.json — this file names outputStyle in the command text, so reading settings.json would self-match and suppress the ask forever.

hooks.command:
L="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/settings.local.json"; case "$(cat "$L" 2>/dev/null)" in *outputStyle*) : ;; *) printf '%s
' '<output-mode-first-run>No output style is set for this project yet. Before starting the task: (1) Ask the user ONE question in their language: keep the default output style, or switch to ADHD Friendly (action-first: next action first, numbered steps, progress restated every turn, no preamble — defined in .claude/output-styles/adhd-friendly.md)? Mention the choice persists for every future session and can be changed anytime via /config or by asking. (2) Merge the answer into .claude/settings.local.json as {"outputStyle":"ADHD Friendly"} or {"outputStyle":"default"}, creating the file if absent. (3) If ADHD Friendly was chosen, read the style file now and follow it for the rest of this session; the harness applies it automatically from the next session. Then proceed with the task.</output-mode-first-run>' ;; esac
test -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.worklog/$(date +%Y%m)" || echo 'WARN: worklog dir missing for this month' >&2
